summary: Feature request to support ToolContext in ADK activity tools. When activity tools have a ToolContext parameter, serialization fails at runtime because ToolContext contains non-serializable objects. User requests a way to pass tool context to wrapped function tools.
userImpact: Users cannot use ToolContext directly in ADK function tools wrapped with activity_tool, requiring workarounds to extract serializable pieces manually.
rootCause: ToolContext contains non-serializable objects, but activity parameters must be serializable since they are sent to the server and may execute on different workers.
proposedFix: Maintainer suggests extracting only serializable pieces from ToolContext as explicit activity parameters, or developing a helper for activities that specifically use ToolContext.state.
workaround: Extract needed pieces from ToolContext before calling the activity and pass them as explicit parameters instead of using the activity_tool wrapper.
keyQuote: Any input type to an activity absolutely does have to be serializable. The activity inputs need to be sent to the server and back, and may run on a different worker
